findings.text: follow-on, non-blocking: read_blobs maps a git-missing object to None, but read_sources copies those bytes-or-None values straight into its returned dict while its docstring promises bytes; a None would reach the counter's text.decode and the detector's _sources_text as an AttributeError rather than the None reading the callers' error contract expects. Unreachable while every path is listed by ls-tree at that same revision, so this is a latent contract gap rather than a live defect.

justifications.durability: tests/test_one_sources_reader_serves_the_detector_and_the_counter.py:104 pins both consumers to the one reader (`interface_counts.read_sources is velocity.read_sources`, `clones.read_sources is velocity.read_sources`) and its spy records the prefixes, and the negative control (private archive reader restored in clones.py) reddens it with `assert '' in by_prefix`, so the guards are shown to fire.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's gate.log carries a header naming revision 24e780675, the tree and the literal pytest command, then 144 passed and a bare EXIT=0; one point withheld because the gate ran at the source head 24e780675 while the reviewed head is the later evidence-only commit 77e0ae4f7, and the run carried no base arm so added_failure_count is unmeasured.
justifications.fit: velocity._tree_paths sits beside _plan_documents, which it generalises, and read_sources sits beside read_blobs, which it composes; the detector imports the two public names and adds only the private _sources_text decoder, following the surrounding style, and introduces no plan, sprint or ticket name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/clones.py:649 reads both revisions through velocity.read_sources with no prefix (the whole tracked tree) and _git/revised_python are gone, so the detector's sources are the one reader's output rather than its own git-archive reader, while the counter parses read_sources under its reckon prefix (interface_counts.py:449).
justifications.reuse: read_sources composes the generalised _tree_paths with the repository's existing read_blobs rather than forking a lister or a blob loop, and retires the detector's duplicate _git/revised_python; a capability search over reckon/ found no other whole-tree .py-at-revision reader to extend, and the counter's former private ls-tree listing is removed in favour of the same reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the 620502534..77e0ae4f7 diff (reckon/clones.py, reckon/velocity.py, reckon/interface_counts.py, the two test files, the evidence fragment and the figure) is inside the manifest's declared write paths, and nothing touches the shared plan, project index or sprint state.
